title: Science and Technology
description: Practice scientific and technical ideas with clear language.

lessons.title: Orbital Mechanics
lessons.text: Gravitational interactions between celestial bodies maintain planetary orbits across billions of years. A small shift in velocity can change the path of a satellite, a moon, or an entire probe mission. Precision matters because even a tiny error becomes a large distance over time.

lessons.title: Reliable Systems
lessons.text: Reliable software does not appear by accident; it is built through small decisions that reduce surprise. Clear inputs, direct feedback, and predictable behavior give users confidence when they return to a system again and again. A calm interface is often a sign that many hidden details have been handled carefully.
